variant: POD-guided supervised spatial modes with bounded envelope and multiscale inputs
objective: sum_i weight_i*(full weighted value error squared / teacher value norm squared + full weighted dimensionless gradient error squared / teacher gradient norm squared)

resume: separately released exact continuation; restore optimizer/RNG/phase/curvature and cumulative elapsed/counts; no automatic reset
